items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: Well, became very close friends. ... And then we became like bosom friends, you know.

ctx.x: He confides in me, and on this trip to Europe he was telling me about how he got his money -- I won't say the amounts, but he's got amounts spread in different places, because before his wife passed, it seemed like he was going to have problems, or something. And judging from what he's saying about the amounts, and he wanted me to advise him on whether he should invest in this or that, and everything, I said, even a stockbroker's not going to advise you to do that, and I'm not a broker, you know.

Well, he's -- I don't want to put this on here. I gather when his wife died he was in New York, at Michael Virgii's Pub. And you were sort of -- you found him sort of a congenial companion, I take it.
